testcase.system-out: Scenario: Display the axis triad at the lower-left of the viewport ✔ Given a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the viewport orientation control displays the Front view ✔ When the user inspects the viewport corners ✔ Then an axis triad appears at the lower-left of the viewport ✔ And the X axis points right and is red ✔ And the Y axis points up and is green ✔ And the Z axis is indicated in blue at the triad origin ✔ And the orientation control remains at the upper-right of the viewport ✔ And the block remains visible
